purpose: Single source of truth for the current delivery: open editable_blend to continue modeling; use browser_glb for browser presentation. Previous READMEs and run records are preserved for history and do not reflect current state.

path_resolution.asset_base: Local Git main checkout / generated_directory; FILM_PHOTO_SHARED_ROOT explicitly overrides the authoring root.
path_resolution.asset_paths: Authoring media paths and reports are relative to ignored_generated/. browser_glb.published_path, code, configs, and docs are relative to the active repository root.

browser_glb.note: PBR derivative optimized for mobile with embedded textures; real-time glass shader differs slightly from Cycles. Edit with .blend above.

current_changes: Cleaned rear text and memo markings.
Rebuilt lens barrel and body surfaces with smooth black finish; inside features three multi-coated optical elements.
Adjusted body color to matching black while preserving leatherette texture.

continuation.instructions: Read AGENTS.md and SHARED_ASSETS.md first. Open editable_blend in Blender MCP at the specified scene; write new outputs to unique run folders without overwriting current delivery or source assets.

viewer.access: Run locally. Check the actual working directory and port; use the authorized private Tailscale network for other devices. Historical URLs are provenance, not current deployment targets.

update_rule: On each new delivery, update this file's version, paths, checksums, source relationship, and status. For a new browser GLB, preserve the authoring path, copy the verified export into tracked public/assets/cameras/<model_id>-<sha256>.glb, record its repository-relative published_path, and update models.json with the public-relative asset path for the same model_id. Verify file presence and checksums before committing. Authoring binaries remain in ignored directories.
